conversations.answer: [CODE_BLOCK_0]In the PromptDescriptor.jsx file, we have added a new div with the classes "whitespace-pre-wrap overflow-x-scroll overflow-y-auto". The "whitespace-pre-wrap" class ensures that the text wraps within its parent div, preserving new lines, spaces, and tabs. The "overflow-x-scroll" and "overflow-y-auto" classes are used to add a scrollbar if the content overflows the parent div, ensuring that the content is not wider than the screen.

conversations.prompt: Eliminate the pre tag and set a monospace font instead
conversations.answer: [CODE_BLOCK_0]In the PromptDescriptor.jsx file, the pre tag was replaced by a div tag. To maintain the monospaced font style, the "font-mono" class was added to this div. This class applies a monospace font, replicating the effect of the pre tag but with more control over styling and layout.
